name: Bookkeeping
description: Invoices and receipts with VAT, attached scans, a profit & loss statement and a balance sheet, for a small business or freelancer.
highlights: Invoices and receipts with net, VAT % and computed VAT and total
Attach the PDF or photo of every invoice and receipt
Profit & loss per month, quarter or year, by category
Balance sheet on any date, with a check that it balances
VAT per quarter: charged, paid and still due
